Agent Name: DataExtraction_Expert , Step Number: 1 , Reason for Mistake: The agent incorrectly assumed that scraping tables or using a specific keyword "Image" would capture all images in a Wikipedia article. In reality, Wikipedia articles contain images embedded directly in the HTML via `` tags, not just in tables. By relying on an incomplete extraction method (scraping tables) instead of parsing the full HTML content initially, the agent failed to retrieve the correct count. Although the agent later corrected the approach in the same turn by switching to full HTML parsing, the initial strategy in Step 1 was fundamentally flawed and led to a failed first attempt, demonstrating a lack of understanding of how Wikipedia image data is structured. Furthermore, the final count of 28 is likely incorrect because Wikipedia often includes placeholder images, thumbnails, or images in navigation/sidebar elements that may not be part of the main article content, but the primary error lies in the initial extraction logic chosen by the DataExtraction_Expert.
